Title: ChatFolders: Folders for your AI chats with ChatGPT Claude, Gemini & Grok | Product Hunt
# ChatFolders. ## Folders for your AI chats with ChatGPT Claude, Gemini & Grok. Stop scrolling through endless AI chats. ChatFolders adds folders to ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and Grok — all in one extension. Drag and drop chats into color-coded folders. Auto-rules sort new chats for you. Local-first — all data stays in your browser. Upgrade for unlimited folders, sub-folders, sync, and more. No reviews yetBe the first to leave a review for ChatFolders. I built ChatFolders because I was drowning in AI conversations across multiple platforms. Finding a specific chat from last week meant endless scrolling through ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini separately. The idea is simple: if email has folders, AI chats should too. Local-first - your data never leaves your browser 3. Lightweight vanilla JS - loads instantly, feels native Free tier gives you 5 folders with drag-and-drop, bookmarks, and tags. Power users can upgrade for unlimited folders, sub-folders, search, auto-rules, and cross-device sync. Would love to hear how you organize your AI conversations today! Is it possible already or do you consider to also allow drag the contents from the folder to AI chats? for example, I might want to ask Claude to look at chatgpt's summary by drag from chatfolder to the claude chat input box and then add more prompts to followup. This is a really interesting use case — being able to share conversation context across different AI platforms would be super powerful. I would like to upgrade but the Paypal link doesn't work for me. The update is currently under review and should be available soon. @guanjie\_zhou Sadly, it's still not working for me, but I can get to Paypal. The latest update has passed Google Chrome’s review, and this issue is now fully fixed. Folders are manual, but we have auto-assignment rules — you can set patterns (contains, starts with, regex) to auto-sort new conversations by title. What made you build this in the first place? I’ve been drowning in ChatGPT / Claude / Gemini chats lately, and scrolling forever to find an old conversation is painful 😅 Love that this works across multiple platforms and keeps data local.
